entities.name: Vec
entities.description: A human tribe, possibly from Dominaria, trapped on Rath by Volrath's will and split into the independent en-Vec and the traitorous il-Vec.

entities.name: en-Vec
entities.description: Semi-nomadic, devout Vec who stayed independent and resisted Volrath.

entities.name: il-Vec
entities.description: Vec traitors who defected to Volrath's service; rogues, opportunists and fire mages.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A human-like race originating on Zendikar, trapped on Rath, divided into il-Kor and en-Kor.

entities.name: Dal
entities.description: A human tribe of warriors and wizards, the only Rathi tribe with permanent settlements, split into en-Dal and il-Dal.

entities.name: il-Dal
entities.description: Dal traitors who served the evincar of Rath; many became shadow creatures after the Invasion.

entities.name: Evincar of Rath
entities.description: Ruler of Rath who experimented on the tribes.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Evincar who trapped the Vec on Rath and commanded the il-Vec.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane where the Kor, Vec and Dal lived in exile.

entities.name: Korvecdal
entities.description: Collective name from the three tribes Kor, Vec and Dal.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that moved Rath's peoples onto Dominaria.

entities.name: Oleg il-Dal
entities.description: Dal man who became the Weaver King, a psychic vampire and manipulator.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: Half il-Vec, half en-Dal; daughter of Aniyeh.

entities.name: City of Traitors
entities.description: City at the heart of the Stronghold whose inhabitants were trapped in the shadow-world after the Overlay.

events.summary: The Vec are trapped on Rath by Volrath's will and divide into en-Vec and il-Vec.
events.quote: who were trapped on the plane of Rath by the will of Volrath

events.summary: The en-Vec unite with Rath's other peoples to resist Volrath.
events.quote: The en -Vec united with the other peoples of Rath in resisting Volrath.

events.summary: After the Overlay, many City of Traitors inhabitants are trapped in the shadow-world.
events.quote: many of the inhabitants of the City of Traitors , located at the heart of the Stronghold , were trapped in the shadow -world between worlds.

events.summary: The Dal are transferred to Dominaria during the overlay.
events.quote: The Dal were transferred to Dominaria during the overlay.

relations.quote: The en -Vec united with the other peoples of Rath in resisting Volrath.
Oleg il- Dal, the Weaver King
